name: Confront Lorthuna
summary: An injured mage asks you to follow Ayessa and Elaadrin through a portal to the Rohashi Spires. They need help confronting High Priestess Lorthuna.

sections.title: Through the portal
sections.body: Lorthuna fled to the spires above by portal, and Ayessa Dawnsinger and Elaadrin Evengale went after her moments ago. Their companion is too badly hurt to follow. Go through the portal and join them as they face the High Priestess.

sections.title: After the clash
sections.body: The remaining mages were sent to help Valennia and her forces escape, and Valennia is resting at High Elder Shadowsong's residence. Ansirem has returned to Azeroth after discussing the High Order's next steps. Zephras survived the day, but is dangerously vulnerable, and plans must be made for what comes next.

faq.q: Who is asking me to go after Lorthuna?
faq.answer: An injured mage asks you to follow Ayessa Dawnsinger and Elaadrin Evengale through the portal and help them confront High Priestess Lorthuna.
Lorthuna fled through a portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead.
Ayessa Dawnsinger and Elaadrin Evengale went through the portal after Lorthuna.

faq.q: Why can't the injured mage go with them?
faq.answer: The mage took too many hits and must stay behind.
Valennia is resting at High Elder Shadowsong's residence after the remaining mages helped her and her forces escape.
Zephras is dangerously vulnerable, and the High Order must make plans for what comes next.
